label.description: What the template is for, as the console offers it: 'Check a page, changing nothing'.

about.description: A sentence or two on when to start from it.

description.description: What the skill checks and when to use it: Hermes's list of skills and the QA console's New run show it.

summary.description: What it does, in a few sentences (Markdown).

safety.description: What it changes in the app: read_only (nothing but logging in), records_activity (the test account's own progress or attempts), creates_data (records titled as the shared contract says).

ai_credits.description: It spends AI credits on the environment.

side_effects.description: What exactly it records or creates (records_activity, creates_data), e.g. 'one learner attempt for the test account'.

arguments.description: What it takes besides the environment, e.g. 'the asset type, a registry slug'.

start_at.description: The page it starts on, from the app's root: /dashboard/quizzes.

rules.description: What to keep to all along: one rule each (Markdown).

sections.description: More sections before the steps (Markdown), e.g. a one-time setup or the credentials a script needs.

steps.description: What to do, in order (Markdown; a step may hold a list, a table or a code block).

screenshots.description: The screenshots the agent saves (none: a script of the skill saves them).

files.description: The screenshots to save, each with when to take it.

report.description: What the report gives after its RESULT line.

pass_if.description: When it passes (any of these). None: whenever no FAIL case holds.

not_a_failure.description: What may look wrong but does not fail it.

skill.description: The skill it starts as: a skill.yaml's fields, with [[…]] where the author's words go.
